newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late palm olein soft on poor interest.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late palm olein soft on poor interest.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices remained soft in late trading on Friday on the back of poor buying interest, traders said.
They said olein was generally holding at 1,375-80 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, but quotes were also heard at 1,370 rupiah. Crude palm oil was last done at 1,165 rupiah/kg in Medan at a tender.

An official from state-run marketing board KPB said its October crude palm oil allocation price would remain unchanged at September's 1,010 rupiah/kg, but declined to comment on talk that the quantity would be reduced this month due to lower than expected output from state plantations.
Traders said market sentiment remained weak and that prices were expected to trend lower next week as fresh olein supplies were scheduled to land in Jakarta.
"One player is expected to unload a shipment of 4,800 tonnes of olein next week," one trader said. "Another 5,500 tonnes ordered by BULOG is also expected to be unloaded next week."

He said the shipment belonging to BULOG, the state logistics agency, was part of a consignment the agency had ordered from Malaysia more than two months ago when it intervened in the market to lower local prices.
